evals.prompt: Create a Seedream storyboard plan and exact prompts for a 15-second chase shot. A rider on a giant eagle flees through a rainforest, a serpent emerges behind them, they weave through vines, and the rider reaches a beach while the serpent stops at the tree line. Use 16:9 and do not invent timestamps.
evals.expected_output: A multi-panel continuity board that splits the action into decisive states, preserves lead-pursuer order and the forest boundary, and provides exact Seedream prompts without mandatory timecodes.
expectations: The output creates more than one panel because the shot contains several meaningful state changes.
The output establishes the eagle ahead of the serpent and keeps the travel direction stable.
The output makes the serpent stop at the inland tree line and remain absent from beach panels.
The output does not add second-level timestamps.
Each panel prompt describes one frozen decisive moment.

evals.prompt: Write the prompts for one coherent set of six storyboard images from my character, location, and prop references. Use Seedream 5.0 Pro and have all six come back in one call.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the requested Pro model and flag its incompatible six-image one-call requirement. Offer a grid, individual Pro calls, or a verified sequence-capable model as unselected alternatives; obtain authorization before any model, call count, or delivery change. A prompt-only caller returns prompts, not generations.
expectations: The output does not claim that Seedream 5.0 Pro supports six-image batch output.
The output offers alternatives without selecting or submitting them; a changed model, call count, or delivery mode requires authorization.
The output checks that references plus generated outputs remain within the selected model limit.
The output preserves explicit roles for character, location, and prop references.
The output delivers prompts only and does not claim any image was generated.

evals.prompt: Use my three-panel character sheet, lighthouse-interior reference, and hand-drawn blocking sketch to write the prompt for a close confrontation. The sketch is layout-only and its colored boxes, arrows, and labels must not appear. The character sheet includes three visible copies of the same person.
evals.expected_output: A reference preflight and exact prompt that identifies leakage risks, assigns each reference a single role, and prevents sketch or character-sheet artifacts from appearing in the frame.
expectations: The output identifies the three-panel character sheet as a possible duplicate-face leakage risk.
The output recommends a clean single-subject derivative or crop when needed.
The output uses the blocking sketch only for composition.
The prompt explicitly removes sketch lines, arrows, colored boxes, and labels.
The prompt binds every reference with an exact @Image N token.

evals.prompt: Revise panel p030. The camera, pose, character identity, left-to-right screen direction, lighting, and lighthouse geometry are approved. Change only the broken oil vial so it lies behind the hunter's right boot. Prepare a precise Seedream edit prompt.
evals.expected_output: A narrow edit prompt that changes only the prop position, names the target panel in words, and preserves every approved property.
expectations: The output separates the requested delta from the locked decisions.
The output names the target panel or region by position and content rather than computing tool coordinates.
The acceptance criteria place the vial behind the hunter's right boot.
The output preserves camera, pose, identity, screen direction, lighting, and geometry.
The output does not treat the edited panel as approved without the user's explicit choice.

evals.prompt: Write a storyboard panel prompt from approved character, kitchen-location, and branded-jar sheets. The character and location are approved, but the jar sheet is still in review. Do not write anything for video yet.
evals.expected_output: An asset-bound storyboard prompt with ordered references and an unresolved jar. The panel is an unlocked planning draft; even later approval does not make it video conditioning.
expectations: The output binds the character, location, and jar to separate exact @Image N roles.
The output lists each reference's role and approval state in the ordered reference list.
The output marks the jar as unresolved or in review and keeps the panel an unlocked draft.
The output states that the panel remains planning-only even after jar approval; later video staging is text, not panel conditioning.
The output does not write a Seedance prompt or claim any generation happened.

evals.prompt: Create the storyboard prompt for my 30-second strawberry jam commercial. I only want one panel for the scene, but I want three visual options to choose from before we use it for Seedance.
evals.expected_output: One hero-beat panel with three requested alternatives of p010. Selection approves planning only; later video staging is translated to text.
expectations: The output creates exactly one narrative panel identified as p010.
The output identifies the scene's strongest representative hero beat.
The output presents v01, v02, and v03 as alternatives of p010 rather than separate story beats.
The output keeps the same subjects, decisive moment, and continuity contract across the three samples, varying only composition or emphasis when variation is requested.
The output records omitted action or transitions as motion notes instead of adding panels.
The output keeps all panel variants planning-only after selection; I2V needs an independent eligible still, while R2V carries board staging in text.

evals.prompt: I'll use your 6-panel storyboard grid as a reference in a Seedance prompt. What do I need to watch for?
evals.expected_output: Reject grid conditioning and translate its shot order and blocking into text, preserving the board for planning.
expectations: The output keeps the grid planning-only and omits it from all video conditioning roles.
The output translates approved staging into shot text, without grid bindings or board-image uploads.
The output explains that number removal, cropping, separate-panel regeneration, selection and hashes do not change planning origin.
The output does not generate or submit anything.

evals.prompt: Plan an L2 storyboard for a static establishing shot, a camera move revealing a hidden doorway, and a held reaction. No panel budget. Use the normal delivery mode.
evals.expected_output: Five decisive panels: one establishing, start/peak/end for the reveal, one reaction; default grid retained.
expectations: Identifies the reveal as key and plans five panels.
Avoids redundant reaction states.
Keeps default grid delivery and approved-element bindings.

evals.prompt: Use L3 for a four-shot chase, but limit the scene to one narrative panel. Give me three visual alternatives.
evals.expected_output: One p010 hero panel with three alternatives; omitted chase states remain motion notes.
expectations: Honors the one-panel budget over L3 coverage.
Keeps v01-v03 as alternatives of p010.
Records omitted states as motion notes and grants no automatic approval.

evals.prompt: Two cells in my six-panel grid each have an extra mug; everything else is approved. Another panel p040 reverses the axis and depicts the wrong beat. Prepare revision instructions.
evals.expected_output: Local edit prompts for mugs and a corrected full prompt for structural p040, preserving unaffected cells.
expectations: Does not regenerate the entire grid merely because two cells fail.
Uses panel regeneration for wrong beat and axis.
Preserves unaffected cells and checks the entire revised result.

evals.prompt: Two edits failed to remove the same extra jar. A third candidate removes it, but the boy now crouches instead of pushing the bench. Is this fixed?
evals.expected_output: Preservation failed; recommends corrected-panel regeneration after repeated same-criterion edit failures.
expectations: Checks pose outside the local edit region.
Rejects the changed pose despite successful jar removal.
Escalates after two failures of the same criterion without approving the result.

evals.prompt: Prompt-only. Use Seedream 5.5 for one six-panel grid. Keep my character and kitchen references in this order. Do not generate.
evals.expected_output: One grid prompt preserving selected 5.5, ordered references and separate settings; no generation or Pro substitution.
expectations: Preserves selected 5.5 and resolves dola-seedream-5-5-261028 only from verified evidence.
Distinguishes one grid image from six native sequential outputs.
Does not add fast optimization, seed or decomposition options without verified tool support.
Prompt-only performs no submission, upload or generation and grants no authorization.

evals.prompt: I selected a future Seedream model with verified single-image generation. Its coordinate-edit wrapper schema is unknown. Fix only the vial in panel p030; the rest is approved.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the future model and all locks. Return the narrow edit intent and unresolved compatibility; do not silently switch to Pro or full-frame generation.
expectations: Separates model generation support from interactive-edit and wrapper support.
Unknown schema remains unresolved, not supported or proven unsupported.
Offers unselected alternatives requiring authorization and performs no submission.
Preserves approved geometry, pose, identity and requested delta.

evals.prompt: Agent mode. Use my selected Seedream 5.5 to return four separate panels in one call. A prior submit timed out before a job ID returned. Try another transport immediately.
evals.expected_output: Explain the incompatible native sequence request while preserving 5.5. Reconcile the ambiguous submission before retrying and obtain authorization for any package change.
expectations: Does not conflate variations or layers with native sequential output.
Agent mode is not authorization for a model, transport or extra-call change.
Reconciles unknown prior submission state rather than blindly resubmitting.
Provides prompt-only handoff if no verified usable transport exists.

evals.prompt: Use my selected storyboard crop as Seedance first-frame input. The rights-cleared crop is label-free and its current hash and approval are recorded.
evals.expected_output: The crop remains planning-only; translate its staging to text without a video reference binding.
expectations: Crop, absent labels, rights, approval, selection and current hash do not make the panel an independent still.
No first_frame binding, upload or submission; the panel remains planning-only.
Offers an independently authored non-board production still only as an unselected alternative.

evals.prompt: This selected grid is supported as R2V reference_image by my destination and has a current hash. Use its six cells for the Seedance shot sequence.
evals.expected_output: Keep the grid out of video inputs and hand off six text staging notes instead.
expectations: The grid stays planning-only despite role compatibility, selection and hashes.
No board reference tokens, upload, generation or automatic manual review.
Carries shot order and blocking into text while preserving approved canon.

evals.prompt: After cleanup of a grid crop, I generated a text-free standalone using that board and its panel prompt. Approve this board-derived regeneration as a video keyframe.
evals.expected_output: Reject conditioning eligibility for the board-derived image, without undoing its planning selection.
expectations: Cleanup, crop and board-derived regeneration remain planning-only, even when text-free.
No new video authority from approval, a new hash or a production-still label.
Requires genuinely independent source lineage and translates the useful staging to text.

evals.prompt: Alongside my board, I selected an independently authored text-free non-board production still. Exact Seedance model/operation/transport first-frame role, rights, consent, current canonical hashes and source lineage are verified.
evals.expected_output: Distinguish the eligible independent still from the board and return a caller handoff with artifact-specific QA.
expectations: The board remains planning-only; an independently eligible still may use the verified first_frame role.
Checks selection, exact support, rights, lineage, current hashes and still QA without promoting the panel.
No generation or approval of unseen media; preserves selected model and reference order.

evals.prompt: I have an independent animated blockout, not a board animatic. Its exact motion role, current hashes, source lineage, rights and selection are verified for the selected Seedance operation and transport.
evals.expected_output: An independent blockout is a conditional motion-reference candidate, not a planning-panel promotion.
expectations: Storyboard animatics remain planning-only while independently animated non-board geometry may be eligible.
Requires exact supported motion role, rights, source lineage, selection and temporal QA.
No blockout generation, upload or claim that a contact sheet proves motion; appearance authority remains separate.

evals.prompt: My historical successful Seedance task used panel p010. Preserve all records, task IDs, hashes and selected variants. Does that make the panel eligible for another generation?
evals.expected_output: Preserve historical provenance unchanged but deny new panel conditioning authority.
expectations: The panel remains planning-only for every new request regardless of historical success.
No rewrite of historical tasks, selections, hashes or approval states.
Translate staging to text and require independent eligibility for any future production reference.

evals.prompt: One-panel storyboard in chat only: no assets or scene beat yet, unknown Seedance role evidence and no generation. Keep the normal defaults.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the missing beat, keep one-panel planning intent and unresolved references, and do not invent an image.
expectations: No generated assets, approval, reference bindings, files or extra calls are invented.
Keeps planning-only purpose, one-panel scope and default review without automatic prompt-review.
Unknown video role evidence stays unresolved; it does not prevent later text staging once the beat is supplied.

evals.prompt: My independent still has wrong-operation role evidence, missing source lineage and unresolved rights. It is selected and text-free; approve it for Seedance anyway.
evals.expected_output: Keep the reference handoff unresolved; independence and selection do not supply rights or exact supported roles.
expectations: Keeps boards planning-only without a blanket ban on genuinely eligible independent stills.
Wrong-operation support, missing lineage and unresolved rights prevent conditioning handoff.
No generation, upload, model substitution or invented authorization; preserve any usable text staging.
